journey.title: Publish a capability
journey.purpose: Walk an operator from 'which scenarios may publish' to a confirmed publication, passing through every gate so that no rung is reached without evidence.

steps.intent: Identify a scenario that is eligible to publish.
Compose a package and find it in the list.
Read the gate ladder and start the next gate.
Read the clean-room evidence as an outsider would.
See that publish is blocked until a release decision exists for this commit.
Publish and confirm the artifact is retrievable at its digest.
